text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh... You want to take me somewhere for a change of pace?
choice_data_list: Because it's a rare day off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lately, I feel like Almond Eye has been pushing herself a bit too hard.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Please! About this week's weight training...
Do you think we could increase the load just a little?
choice_data_list: Still, aren't you pushing yourself a bit too hard?
Still, aren't you pushing yourself a bit too hard?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That's not true! I still have plenty of strength left before I reach my limit.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"If taking one more step means I might win more...
then of course I'm gonna go for it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted her to at least be able to fully refresh
herself on her days off—and with that in mind,
I had made preparations for this day.
choice_data_list: Won't you leave it to me?
Won't you leave it to me?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Well then, I might just take you up on that.
Fufu, I have high expectations, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the place I brought her to
was a certain tourist spot.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so many glamorous shops.
Hehe, I might get distracted looking at them all.
choice_data_list: This place is famous for its matcha frappe.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds nice.
Um, the matcha frappe shop was—
choice_data_list: It's fine! I'll go buy enough for both of us!
It's fine! I'll go buy enough for both of us!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? I'd feel bad doing that.
I told you, I'm coming with you."
choice_data_list: Because I want you to take it easy and relax.
Because I want you to take it easy and rest.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? Hmm...
Well, in that case, maybe I'll ask for your help.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...♪ It's so smooth, with just the right touch of bitterness!
I can see why it's so popular.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right? Since we came all the way to a tourist spot,
let's look around at various places after this.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me! I've got a list right here.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? A list...?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"‘◆ Plan A: Visit a shrine.
A sacred spiritual power spot.
According to literature, it boasts numerous legends—’"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is packed with descriptions of sightseeing spots...!
Must've been pretty tough looking all of this up, huh?
choice_data_list: I just looked it up a little before bed.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"A little"? You call this "a little"...?
Don't tell me those dark circles under your eyes are—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...No, thank you.
But please, don't push yourself too hard, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we decide on our destination?
Let's see, which one should we pick—
choice_data_list: Before that, could you come with me for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait, Trainer!?
What is the meaning of thisâ

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey, this isn't a rickshaw!
choice_data_list: I'll be your driver so you don't get tired!
I'll be your driver so you don't get tired!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I contacted the rental company,
they said they could rent just the rickshaw for dirt cheap.
There's no way we shouldn't take advantage of this!
choice_data_list: I'll be your legs! Come on, hop on!
I'll be your legs! Come on, hop on!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
…………
Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Of course it's not fine! That's totally absurd!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I see...
So it's to help me refresh, is it...?
choice_data_list: You seem a little worn out, so...
You seem a little tired, so...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm genuinely happy to hear how you feel.
However—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You're pushing yourself a bit too hard, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You're giving it too much power, narrowing your field of vision.
Keep a little more... composure—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (...Come to think of it—)
choice_data_list: Still, aren't you pushing yourself a bit too hard?
Still, aren't you pushing yourself a bit too hard?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's nothing.
Just that, you see—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I just thought, we really are the same.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it's decided!
You're going to rest with me today too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No more fussing over me.
Let's both take a break and refresh together. ...What do you say?
choice_data_list: ...Ah, I'd be happy to! Count me in!
...Yeah, I'd gladly join you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there's a hot spring facility over there, I see.
...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Look, look at that!
"An exquisite footbath experience for you..."
Come on, let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew...♪ The water is just the right temperature...
choice_data_list: This is absolute paradise...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaah... The breeze feels so refreshing after a bath...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you have such a relaxed look on your face.
...You've been so busy lately, after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Adjusting the race schedule,
refining the training regimen...
You've been working late into the night, haven't you?
choice_data_list: Because I want to work just as hard as you.
Because I want to work hard just like you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, you mustn't push yourself too hard, okay?
You have to rest properly when you can.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Or something like that.
Though coming from me, it might not sound very convincing."
choice_data_list: Then I'll keep you company again whenever you want to rest
Then, I'll hang out with you again whenever you want to take a break.
We both need to be careful.
We both need to be careful.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Or something like that.
Though coming from me, it might not sound very convincing."
choice_data_list: Then I'll keep you company again whenever you want to rest
Then, I'll hang out with you again whenever you want to take a break.
We both need to be careful.
We both need to be careful.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that might be best.
You might be pushing yourself too hard, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, let's let loose and relax to our hearts' content.
Just like today!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right, because you lose sight of your surroundings.
You do, and so do I.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"So, remember this.
I'm keeping a very close eye on you."
